title: Opening a Dual Ingestion Lane
description: 2026-06-10. I am working on OpenText ingestion and a contextual semantic retrieval lane. The purpose is to make the platform more dependable in actual use, with evidence that can be inspected rather than an assumption that a feature is complete.
body:
2026-06-10. I am working on OpenText ingestion and a contextual semantic retrieval lane. The purpose is to make the platform more dependable in actual use, with evidence that can be inspected rather than an assumption that a feature is complete.

What this changes

The implementation records a specific operating path and makes its controls visible. It creates a basis for later testing, correction, and review instead of treating the initial change as a final result.

Historical basis: 2026-06-10 repository milestone, commit bdf7cce.
